newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.4 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.4 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated at 0.4 percent the week ended February 17, unchanged from the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wedndesday.
Inflation for the whole of February will be 1.5 percent if current price trends continue, it said. The monthly rate in January was 2.3 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended Feb 17 Feb 10
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.6 +0.8
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.111 +0.143
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
